profile.headline: Expert Software Developer - Web/.Net/Database Developer at Allscripts

positions.title: Expert Software Developer - Web/.Net/Database Developer
positions.description:
• Development and Design of a C# Electronic Health Record (EHR) Web Application utilizing MVC and MVVM Architectural Patterns, SQL Server 2014, WebAPI Framework, jQuery, Kendo UI and Javascript to provide hospitals and ambulatory health care organizations the ability to manage all aspects of clinical care.
• Designed and Developed EHR Features as follows:
   • Numerous Ambulatory Care features such as Multi-Appointment Treatment Plan functionality and 
     special Ambulatory laboratory/radiology ordering of within this new segment of business
   • Third Party Vendor Interaction for Ambulatory Care Setting
   • Computerized Physician Ordering Entry to allow ordering all types of prescription and order 
     management orders.
   • Various Patient Profile and Care Assignment modules.
• Research and Development of Restful Web Service advanced medical evidence interface with a third-party vendor as well as the applications which utilized this Web API.
• Maintained a VB.Net/SQL Server EHR Web Application utilizing SQL Server 2014/2012, HTML and Javascript used in hospitals across the country.
• Strong team player in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Environment with 2 Week Sprints and 3 Month Planning Increments.
• Development Environments include Visual Studio 2017/2015.
• Database Design including table design, developed numerous stored procedures, functions, triggers and indexes as well as performance optimization to resolve slow-running code.
• Unit Testing Frameworks – MOQ and MSTest
• Provided on-going .NET and SQL Server mentoring to both onshore and offshore developers and Quality Assurance Analysts.
• Interfaced with Product Owners, Client Support and Customers to determine business requirements using Agile Development Methodologies.
• Interfaced with external clients to analyze escalated issues and determine goal-oriented solutions.

positions.title: Senior C# Developer
positions.description:
• Developed C# Accounts Payable applications for small to mid-size companies
• Development of C# Web API Services to interface with 3rd party REST and SOAP APIs utilizaing Windsor Dependency Injection and Quartz Job Scheduler API
• Development of C# Multi-threaded Windows Services using LINQ, Concurrent Queues and X.509 Client and Server Certificates
• Development of C# MVC 4 Applications utilizing SQL Server 2017 and 2014 with nHibernate and Entity Framework, Javascript, jQuery and Bootstrap
• Database Development of SQL Server 2017 Stored Procedures, Tables, Views and Triggers
• Azure Function Development utilizing Azure Queues along with Integration with existing MVC Applications
• Product Research of 3rd party APIs as well as interfacing with 3rd party vendors 
• Team Foundation Service, git, Visual Studio Team Services Source Control Systems, TeamCity Build Management and Octopus Deployment Application
• Agile Development Process including Quarterly Planning Sessions, Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Daily Standups and Retrospectives.  Feature and Story Management via Rally.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Developing a C# Electronic Medical Record (EMR) Web Application utilizing MVC and MVVM Architectural Patterns, SQL Server 2014/2012, WebAPI Services, jQuery, Kendo UI, Knockout and Javascript to provide health care organizations ability to manage all aspects of clinical care.
•	Developing a VB.Net/SQL Server EMR Web Application utilizing SQL Server 2014/2012, HTML and Javascript used in hospitals across the country.  
•	Designed and Developed EMR Features include:
•	Health Information Exchange functionality to import patient information from other healthcare organizations.
•	Computerized Physician Ordering Entry to allow ordering all types of prescription and order management orders.
•	Medication Reconciliation to facilitate creation of the most accurate list of medications taken by a patient upon hospital admission as well as during discharge.
•	Prescription Writer functionality including electronically sending medications to pharmacies.
•	Advanced medical evidence based ordering interface with 3rd party vendors.
•	Various Patient Profile and Care Assignment modules.
•	Developing in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Environment with 2 Week Sprints, 3 Month Program Increments to plan and adjust accordingly for changing requirements and priorities.
•	Development Environments include Visual Studio 2015/2012.
•	Database Design including table design, developed numerous stored procedures, functions, triggers and indexes as well as performance optimization to resolve slow-running code.
•	Developed and Integrated Reporting Functionality into EMR Web Applications utilizing SQL Server Reporting Services API.
•	Provided on-going .NET and SQL Server mentoring and support to other .NET developers and Quality Assurance Analysts.
•	Interfaced with Business Analysts and Product Management to determine business requirements using both Waterfall and Agile Development Methodologies.
•	Interfaced with external clients to analyze escalated issues and determine goal oriented solutions.

positions.title: Senior Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed Call Center Windows Application which integrates with Avaya Telephony APIs to provide various soft phone functionality and integration with IBM Mainframe
•	Developed an HTML5 Mobile Sales Application optimized for the iPhone and iPad utilizing jQueryMobile, jQuery and JSON 
•	Development of various internal and customer facing ASP.NET Web applications and Windows .NET applications with SQL Server 2008/2005 databases written in Visual Studio 2010, 2008 and 2005
•	Developed and implemented a secure password extraction Web Service to retrieve frequently changed application passwords from a 3rd party password vault.  This Web Service is accessed using SSL and is called by all National Gypsum Web and Windows .Net applications to retrieve passwords for application specific users used when querying databases.  
•	Designed how National Gypsum would implement and use client authentication certificates required for the aforementioned password extraction Web Service which was accessed via SSL.  Worked with security team to distribute these client certificates via group policy.
•	Developed Windows Services applications which performed document delivery of  SQL Server 2008 Reporting Services reports to customers via email and fax.  Types of documents delivered include invoices, credit memos, month-end statements, order/price change notifications.  
•	Notification Windows Service handled dynamic creation of SSRS 2008 XML report definitions based upon customer chosen report criteria and called the Reporting Services Web Service to create reports which were automatically delivered to customers.
•	Continued to develop and support manufacturing cost accounting systems from previous contract work I had completed at National Gypsum.  These systems handle journal entry and inventory control processing that interface between an IBM mainframe, various SQL databases and SAP. 
•	Created numerous SQL Server SSIS Packages.
•	Developed ETL enhancements for OLAP cubes.

positions.title: Senior .NET/SQL Developer
positions.description:
•	Contracted via Apex Systems.
•	Developed Server SQL 2005 Integration Services packages and SQL Server 2005 Reporting Services projects which process manufacturing cost accounting data from multiple input channels to produce various manufacturing solutions, including input to data cubes and reporting for senior management, financial accounting, manufacturing and operations accounting
•	Developed VB.Net Windows Service accessing SQL Server databases to automate creation of product pricing Excel spreadsheets and delivery via email and/or fax
•	Converted classic ASP pages to ASP.NET 
•	Developed VB.NET 2005 Windows applications to automate pricing administration features and initiate processing SSIS packages from user desktops while utilizing input parameters entered by the user via the Windows application
•	Designed and developed multiple SQL Server 2005 and 2000 tables, stored procedures, user-defined functions, views, Data Transformation Services packages, SQL Server Integration Services packages
•	Interfaced with various internal customers to determines user requirements and educate end users during system implementation

positions.title: Senior Web/Database Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed VB.NET/ASP.NET web applications accessing SQL Server databases for various marketing clients.  Applications also utilized SQL Server 2000 Reporting Services API, Javascript, XML, ASP, HTML, and VBScript.
•	Created numerous SQL Server 2000 Reporting Services reports used for daily operational tasks as well as business intelligence reporting.  
•	Analyzed and developed OLAP Star/Snowflake Schemas and Cubes using SQL Server 2000/2005 Analysis Services.  Designed the underlying databases containing the dimension/fact tables as well as the ETL process to populate these tables from the original OLTP database.
•	Designed and developed multiple SQL Server 2000 OLTP databases.
•	Programmed extensively with SQL Server 2000 creating Data Transformation Services (DTS) packages and tasks.
•	Developed stored procedures, triggers, user-defined functions, views.
•	Interfaced with external and internal clients to determine user and system requirements for both web and database applications.
